programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts a double-date pizza party on the farm and takes the Italian grilling outside; she makes cheesy fried risotto balls, grilled zucchini pizza with basil mint pesto and a crisp Romaine salad drizzled in bacon fat vinaigrette.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh makes a housewarming dinner of Midwest-Jewish mashups; the menu includes BBQ brisket sandwich with caraway coleslaw on pretzel challah buns, scallion cream cheese grilled corn and rugelach cookie salad for dessert.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh and husband Nick celebrate wheat harvest with a tractor tailgate party on the farm; Molly makes colorful sheet pan ratatouille pizza, succulent grilled rib eye steak on feta farro with garden veggies, and tangy rhubarb bars for dessert.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: After a good workout, Molly Yeh rewards her exercise buddies by grilling Margherita and Prosciutto Pizzettes, Corn with Spicy Calabrian Chili Butter and her version of the Hagen House Salad.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.sub_title: Long Days, Late Night BBQ Date
programs.desc: For her late-night date night with Nick, Molly Yeh pulls out all the stops with her juicy steak party sub and scrumptious grilled potato salad with zhoug mayo; she makes orange blossom blondie ice cream coated in a white chocolate raspberry shell.

programs.title: The Pioneer Woman
programs.desc: Sticky oven roasted barbecue chicken thighs; grilled vegetables with cilantro-yogurt dressing; spicy pasta salad with smoked gouda, tomatoes and basil; vanilla ice cream with peach syrup.
